  -- Observation: Edward Dearle lived from 1806 to 1891 (85 years). Michael Doeberl lived from 1861 to 1928 (67 years).
  -- Thought: Edward Dearle lived longer than Michael Doeberl. The initial conclusion in the trace was incorrect due to a data error in the Planner's analysis step (it incorrectly stated Edward Dearle died in 1861).
  -- Result: Correctly identified that Edward Dearle lived longer (85 years vs 67 years).
